# Individual forbidden-target recovery

These are signed prior-relative gains in nats; lower measured gain is better. Each cell is mean ± sample SD over all three seeds, including unsuccessful conditions. Unweighted validation selects each attack; PWGTP scores those same predictions. No recovery values are clipped. These are DEVELOPMENT EVALUATION observations, not protection certificates.

The tables use expanded catch-up at 360 epochs. Reserved opposing targets have no own training observer; static E has no inherited observer at all. [PER_SEED.csv](PER_SEED.csv), [AGGREGATE.csv](AGGREGATE.csv), and [AUDIT_SCOPE.csv](AUDIT_SCOPE.csv) retain every seed, all three scopes, both budgets and the matching losses/priors. The full nine-class race assessment remains unassessable because code 4 lacks independent fitting/validation support. No new threshold for opposing-task recovery is introduced.
